summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the 'Consider as Paid Leave' admin feature (Apply-for-Employee dialog + Approve dialog). Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass covering apply/approve/reject/reserve/finalize/release flows, intern 403, half-day/full-day limits, insufficient-balance 400 with 'Cannot mark as Paid Leave: insufficient', advance-month generate+approve, idempotent double-approve. Frontend: Verified all data-testids and conditional UI (admin-consider-paid-box shows only for eligible Full-time; approve-consider-paid-checkbox toggles replace approve-lop-select with approve-paid-note; approve-consider-paid-hint shows insufficient balance message; checkbox disabled for 0-balance; intern approve has no paid box, LOP select still present). Regression: Leave Requests, History, Paid Leave Management tabs all load. Cleanup performed at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 9816: find_one_and_update claim correctly guards against double-reservation (consider_as_paid_leave $ne True) — good atomicity.
server.py line 9828: rollback on reservation failure correctly re-raises as 400 with the clear 'Cannot mark as Paid Leave: insufficient...' message — matches review requirement.
Leave.js line 894: apply dialog paid checkbox is disabled when balance <= 0, but admin-consider-paid-box only renders when adminPaidBalance.eligible — correct per spec (intern hides fully).

Minor: paid_leave_generation.generate adds +1 to ALL eligible employees in local DB — test suite correctly isolates this to a future year (2030-01) and cleans it up, but behaviour is destructive if run on wrong DB.
seed_data_creation: Used /app/backend/tests/seed_paid_leave_test_data.py seed; cleanup run at end. 3 ad-hoc pending leaves inserted via mongo for UI test and were deleted by cleanup (reason prefix TEST_PL). paid_leave_generation year=2030 month=1 record created and deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is pytest-based and auto-seeds+cleans each run. Admin login works with admin/pass123 locally. Login response field is 'token' (not 'access_token'). Date picker in Apply-for-Employee dialog is custom and difficult to drive via Playwright — bypass by inserting pending leaves directly in Mongo when testing the Approve dialog UI. generate endpoint affects ALL eligible employees so use a far-future year/month and delete afterwards.
rca of the issue: n/a — feature implemented correctly, all tests pass
